scientific_integrity: Self-review of a constructive proof and reproducible finite checks; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: The result counts the optimum size and characterizes feasible two-/three-vertex maximal-geodesic counts but does not count all optimal families or extend to arbitrary graphs. Possible historical overlap under induced-P3 packing terminology remains. Finite checks do not replace the Hall proof.
title: Geodesic packings of complete multipartite graphs: three sharp capacity constraints
